source.test: ConfigManager.init — blank remote_api_token is not migrated

notes: A whitespace-only remote_api_token fails ConfigManager.init's own !oldToken.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines).isEmpty guard (source line 80), so nothing is written to SecretStore. The key is still stripped from the rewritten config either way -- AppConfig never carries it regardless of whether it held a real secret.
